# clavis share

<p class="cli-lead">Create a client-encrypted one-time share link</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis share KEY [flags]
```

</div>

Create a one-time link for a single secret, for handing a value to a
person. The value is encrypted on your machine; only ciphertext is
uploaded and the key stays in the link's `#fragment`, which never
reaches the server.

## Examples

```sh
clavis share DATABASE_URL
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Valid for 2 hours and 3 views</p>

```sh
clavis share API_KEY --ttl 2h --views 3
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Also require a password</p>

```sh
clavis share API_KEY --prompt-password
```

<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-password"><dt><code>--password string</code></dt><dd>optional password required to claim</dd></div>

</dl>

## Details

The server enforces expiry, view limits and the optional password. Share links are for people, not automation.
